text: In the snowy mountains, a small lone figure carrying a spear walks across a white mountainside deep in snow.
The figure falls face down in the snow, motionless.
A young woman with short red hair takes an apple from a large dark sleeve.
She holds a spiky green fruit, turns.
A woman runs, leaps, climbs a wall.
